configurePresets.name: Debug

configurePresets.name: SensorDebug
configurePresets.description: Compiles APP_NODE_ROLE=SENSOR and outputs Env-Monitor_sensor.* for the acquisition board.

configurePresets.name: MonitorDebug
configurePresets.description: Compiles APP_NODE_ROLE=MONITOR and outputs Env-Monitor_monitor.* for OLED, alarm, buttons, and flash logging.

configurePresets.description: Generic release preset; use SensorDebug or MonitorDebug for the two-board demo images.
